{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-3zc3","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: Rust transcript_2 uses raw concat instead of CBOR sequence","description":"The Rust `transcript_2` function in `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:414` uses raw byte concatenation for TH_2 input (`g_y || h_msg1`) instead of CBOR sequence encoding (`CBOR(g_y) || CBOR(h_msg1)`).

**Evidence from RFC 9529 Section 2.2 test vectors:**

- G_Y raw: `dc88d2d51da5ed67fc4616356bc8ca74ef9ebe8b387e623a360ba480b9b29d1c`
- H(message_1) raw: `c165d6a99d1bcafaac8dbf2b352a6f7d71a30b439c9d64d349a23848038ed16b`

| Method | TH_2 result |
|--------|-------------|
| Raw concat (Rust) | `c1d8c6ee4eeb1672d7fcbb44f8d811419739b79b852fce03f527eacdaf6633c4` |
| CBOR sequence (spec) | `c6405c154c567466ab1df20369500e540e9f14bd3a796a0652cae66c9061688d` |
| RFC 9529 expected | `c6405c154c567466ab1df20369500e540e9f14bd3a796a0652cae66c9061688d` |

CBOR sequence matches the RFC test vector. Raw concatenation does not.

**Fix needed in Rust:** `transcript_2` should CBOR-encode each element (using `encode_bstr`) instead of raw `extend_err`. The Python implementation was fixed in commit 803878c9a4, so the two implementations are now out of sync — only Rust has this bug.

**Note:** The doc comment at line 414 says 'raw concatenation, per RFC 9528 Appendix C.1.1 test vectors' — this is incorrect; the RFC 9529 test vectors confirm CBOR sequence encoding.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T20:10:08.937800061Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T20:10:08.937800061Z"}
